$Comment: The ultimate's freeze (2026-10-21: the ultimate freezes everything, even his ice creatures, but hurts no ice creature; his other ice attacks still never freeze them). Copy of AT_Ice_King_Freeze (same ice block, shell, screen overlay, movement and ability locks) WITHOUT the Immunity_Freeze apply condition, so it also lands on the Gunters, snowmen and the king's other ice allies, which carry vanilla Immunity_Freeze (role CombatConfig EntityEffects) and are skipped by every normal freeze. The warmth potion still stops it. Only used by AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Mob_Tick/_Final (the beam on non-players); players get the normal freeze from the frost stacks and the last tick. If AT_Ice_King_Freeze changes, copy it again and drop the Immunity_Freeze condition. Ice block variants (2026-10-21: not always the same block): the Spawn set lists Ice_Block_Spawn, Ice_Block_Spawn_B (taller, twisted) and Ice_Block_Spawn_C (wide and low, top crystal tipped) with Weight 1 each; the client picks one and holds its shape while the freeze lasts. Same model and texture. More variants (2026-10-21: cool ones): the model is now Ice_Block_Variants.blockymodel = Ice_Block plus hidden extra crystals (X1-X8 tall, Y1-Y4 small) that only the new Spawn variants show: D crown of spikes on the head crystal, E burst of crystals, F glacier slabs leaning on the block, G two tall spires. Seven Spawn animations, Weight 1 each. Ice_Block.blockymodel itself is untouched (edits to it must be copied into the variants model, or rerun the ice_block_cool.py). 20 variants (2026-10-21/22: only one or two should cover him fully, one a snowman, the rest spaced chunks that let him show): Ice_Block_Variants.blockymodel (every part hidden by default, plus pools X1-X8 / Y1-Y8 / C01-C12, all animatable; the head crystal centred on a vanilla Player) with Spawn = Ice_Block_V01..V20, Weight 1 each: V01 full block, V02 full + crown of spikes, V03 snowman, V04-V20 partial (legs, feet slab, torso band, pauldrons, diagonal, arms, back spikes, head, chest burst, spiral, left / right cluster, glacier, spires, scattered, cage, chest and head). Despawn = Ice_Block_V_Despawn (empty: the pieces vanish at once; the old break animation would show the full block). Generator: the ice_block_v20.py.
